scenario_description:
Objective: Capture optional sky-brightness readings alongside the confirmed Moth Count Listening Night without changing its paper-tally baseline.
Emerging Need: A spare city meter is only an abstract opening while the night event is tentative; later turnout evidence and confirmation make the add-on worthwhile for visitors.
Decision Context: A stored checkout procedure identifies the asset tag, proper custodian, no-phone-substitute rule, activity-label requirement, and midweek queue cutoff needed for a reversible no-cost hold.
Consequence: Timely coordination could add a simple comparison point to the program; after the checkout queue locks, the night proceeds normally without numeric skyglow context.

parameter.title: Moth Count Listening Night
parameter.description: Tentative volunteer night observation at the west shelter porch; ordinary paper tally sheets are the baseline and light-meter add-ons are not assumed.

parameter.subject: Unused skyglow meter slot for early September night programs
parameter.body: The early September kit shelf appears to have one unused city skyglow meter slot. It can be paired with a confirmed public night observation through the routine volunteer checkout; otherwise the meter will stay reserved for staff surveys. The checkout queue closes midweek.

parameter.content: The shelter desk signup sheet ended with nine neighbors choosing the moth-count porch session over the general trail walk. Two families specifically asked whether the park lights would make a difference to what they see on the sheet.

parameter.title: Moth Count Listening Night
parameter.description: Confirmed staffed public night observation at the west shelter porch; ordinary paper tally sheets remain the baseline, with table space available for one optional sky-brightness reading if checked out through the city kit process.

parameter.subject: Skyglow meter checkout queue locked
parameter.body: The volunteer kit checkout queue for early September night-program skyglow meters locked at 16:30 today. New volunteer-side meter additions will roll to a later program cycle.
